title: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
description: A rare humanitarian ceasefire allowed civilians to evacuate the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky.

title: Five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
description: Hampshire Police believes an unknown group gained entry to the party at an address in Chandler's Ford.

title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
description: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.

title: Nowak family tell of 'unbelievable pain' of seeing footage of dying son handcuffed
description: His family describe the night police told them of his death, and watching him being handcuffed.

title: King to address slavery in Antigua as PM says he is open to possible UK apology
description: King Charles III will deliver a speech to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting on Tuesday as he concludes his nine-day Caribbean tour.

title: Tributes to 'inspirational' Olympian Ciara Mageean after death at 34
description: The former European 1500m champion had bowel cancer and died just three weeks after marrying her partner.

title: After a 28-year trek around the world, homebound Karl Bushby crosses the Humber Bridge
description: The British adventurer is due to complete his 31,000-mile challenge in Hull on Monday.

title: Peaceful protests in Germany spiral into violence and looting
description: Thousands joined largely orderly demonstrations earlier in the day, before violence erupted in Frankfurt, Berlin, Cologne and Hamburg.

title: Armed police start patrols in Sydney after Bondi Beach attack
description: The new police unit is a security measure in response to last year's deadly shooting attack at a Hanukkah festival.
